**Why Us?:**

Fillauer is a global leader in orthotic and prosthetic innovation that empowers clinicians and patients to achieve their best functional outcomes. With manufacturing and R&D locations in Tennessee, Utah, and Sweden, Fillauer supports a strong upper limb product line, a robust offering of prosthetic feet, a variety of orthotic devices, and a collection of tools, equipment, components, and materials. Founded over a century ago, Fillauer is dedicated to helping individuals with limb loss and limited mobility return to daily activities and achieve new heights. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.

**Could This Be For You?:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for providing operational leadership for Fillauer's Chattanooga operations. This role oversees day-to-day performance, including Manufacturing, Machine Shop Operations, Assembly, Facilities, Continuous Improvement, and Operational Excellence initiatives. The Director of Operations supports safety, quality, delivery, productivity, employee engagement, customer satisfaction, and cost performance.

This leader will drive operational execution while supporting the systems, processes, and talent necessary to meet current and future production needs. The Director of Operations will partner closely with Engineering, Product Development, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Sales, and Finance to support alignment between business objectives and manufacturing performance. A key responsibility of this role is supporting a high-performing culture through coaching, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Your Impact:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Provide operational leadership for Chattanooga manufacturing operations, including Machine Shop, Assembly, and other Production Support functions.
* Execute operational plans that contribute to business growth, customer satisfaction, quality objectives, and cost performance.
* Lead daily, weekly, and monthly operating reviews to monitor performance, identify risks, and drive accountability.
* Ensure achievement of key performance indicators related to safety, quality, productivity, on-time delivery, inventory, and cost performance.
* Drive operational excellence initiatives that improve throughput, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and optimize resource utilization.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability for operational results across functional areas.
* Partner with cross-functional leaders to remove barriers and improve production performance.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Build, develop, and coach a high-performing team consisting of managers, supervisors, and team leads.
* Establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and employee engagement.
* Conduct talent review and development activities to strengthen team capability and organizational readiness.
* Identify and develop high-potential employees through coaching, development plans, mentoring, and advancement opportunities.
* Ensure consistent application of performance management practices and accountability standards.
* Foster open communication, employee involvement, and strong leadership visibility.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee relations, organizational development, and talent acquisition activities.

**Manufacturing & Quality Excellence**

* Ensure manufacturing operations consistently meet production schedules, quality standards, and customer requirements.
* Implementation of manufacturing best practices, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support compliance with FDA, ISO 13485, OSHA, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Quality leadership to maintain effective quality systems, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities.
* Drive root-cause analysis and long-term corrective actions for operational challenges.

**Financial Management**

* Manage labor plans, departmental spending, and cost improvement initiatives.
* Monitor and improve key operational performance metrics including labor efficiency, overhead absorption, inventory performance, and cost of goods sold.
* Provide input on capacity, staffing, and capital investment requirements to support current and future production needs.
* Contribute to business cases for capital investments, automation, equipment upgrades, and resource needs.

**Operational Planning & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Support the Regional Vice President of Operations in executing operational initiatives and achieving business objectives.
* Lead initiatives that improve scalability, operational maturity, and cross-functional alignment.
* Maintain effective operating rhythms and communication processes to improve decision-making and organizational alignment.
* Contribute to facility planning and operational readiness to support business growth.
* Champion a culture focused on customer satisfaction, employee engagement, operational excellence, and innovation.

**Safety, Facilities & Environmental Compliance**

* Promote a safe work environment and a culture of safety.
* Oversee facility maintenance, equipment reliability, preventative maintenance programs, and site infrastructure investments.
* Maintain compliance with all environmental, health, and safety requirements.
* Lead initiatives focused on improving workplace conditions, efficiency, and employee experience.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience leading managers and multi-functional operations teams.
* Must have, or be eligible to obtain, a valid driver’s license and driving record within the standards outlined within Hanger’s Motor Vehicle Safety Policy and Procedures.

**Additional Success Factors:**

* Experience supporting manufacturing operations in a regulated, quality-driven environment.
* Strong understanding of lean manufacturing, operational excellence, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proven success driving operational performance, employee engagement, and organizational change.
* Experience managing budgets, resource allocation, and operational performance metrics.
* Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and team-building skills.
* Keep the patient at the center of everything that you do, building lifelong trust.
* Foster open collaboration and constructive dialogue with everyone around you.
* Continuously innovate new solutions, influencing and responding to change.
* Focus on superior outcomes, and calibrate work processes for outstanding results.

**Our Investment in You:**

* Competitive Compensation Packages
* 8 Paid National Holidays & 4 additional Floating Holidays
* PTO that includes Vacation and Sick time
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* 401k Savings and Retirement Plan
* Paid Parental Bonding Leave for New Parents
* Flexible Work Schedules and Part-time Opportunities
* Generous Employee Referral Bonus Program
* Mentorship Programs- Mentor and Mentee
* Student Loan Repayment Assistance by Location
* Relocation Assistance
* Regional & National traveling CPO/CO/CP opportunities
* Volunteering for Local and National events such as Hanger’s BAKA Bootcamp and EmpowerFest

Hanger, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship. All conditions and privileges of employment are administered to all employees without discrimination or harassment because of race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, marital status, medical condition, physical or mental disability, military service, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, special disabled veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws and ordinances. The company will comply with all applicable state or local fair employment laws that forbid discrimination or harassment on the basis of other protected characteristics. Retaliation against any employee for filing or supporting a complaint of discrimination or harassment is prohibited.

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

* Vision insurance

**Director of Operations**

**Location: Bowling Green, KY**

**Salary Range: $100,000 – $120,000 + 15% Performance Bonus**

**About Bluegrass Supply Chain**

Bluegrass Supply Chain provides a comprehensive suite of value-added warehousing services and transportation management solutions designed to enhance operational efficiency. By expanding capacity and capabilities, reducing touchpoints and travel time, and improving on-time performance, Bluegrass enables customers to focus on their core business while remaining competitive in the marketplace.

Learn more at www.bsc3pl.com

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations reports directly to the Vice President of Operations and provides strategic and operational leadership across multiple facilities and/or customer-based business units.

This role is responsible for driving overall operational performance, ensuring processes are efficient, scalable, and aligned with Bluegrass Supply Chain’s strategic objectives. The Director plays a critical role in operational excellence, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and team member engagement.

**Why Join Bluegrass Supply Chain?**

This is an opportunity to shape and scale multi-site operations within a growing 3PL organization. The Director of Operations will play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence, strengthening customer partnerships, and developing high-performing teams.

Requirements:

**Strategic & Operational Leadership**

* Provide leadership oversight across multiple locations or business units, ensuring consistent execution of company standards and objectives.
* Serve as a key liaison between operational teams and senior leadership, clearly communicating performance metrics, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Drive alignment between operations strategy and company growth objectives.
* Operational Excellence & Process Optimization
* Establish and monitor quality control and performance management systems.
* Evaluate operational workflows to improve efficiency, cost control, safety, and service quality.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization efforts.
* Identify operational risks and implement mitigation and contingency strategies.

**Customer & Service Excellence**

* Maintain a strong customer-centric focus, ensuring operations align with service-level agreements and customer expectations.
* Proactively solicit customer feedback and drive service improvements.

**Financial & Resource Management**

* Oversee labor planning, workforce optimization, and resource allocation.
* Manage equipment, materials, and operational assets to ensure optimal utilization.
* Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning initiatives.

**Team Member Experience (TMX) & Leadership Development**

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Coach and develop operational leaders and high-potential talent.
* Support professional development and succession planning efforts.

**Technology & Innovation**

* Evaluate and implement technology solutions, including WMS enhancements and automation tools.
* Improve productivity, accuracy, and scalability through systems optimization.
* Act as a role model for Bluegrass Supply Chain’s core values and leadership principles.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or related field required
* MBA or other Masters degree in logistics, supply chain, etc., strongly preferred
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive operations leadership experience, preferably within a 3PL or warehousing environment
* Hands-on experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and executive presentation skills
* Demonstrated expertise in strategic problem-solving, project management, and process improvement
* Proven leadership, negotiation, and change management capabilities

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Bluegrass Supply Chain is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

**Definition:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for planning, directing, and coordinating the overall field operations of a business unit throughout a designated geographical area. Duties and responsibilities include formulating processes and best practices, managing daily operations and clinical compliance, and effectively and efficiently planning and executing the use of equipment, materials, and personnel to best meet the needs of customers, facilities, and the community in which it serves.

**Specific Duties:**

* Demonstrates complete knowledge, understanding and compliance of company policies and procedures.
* Works with the Business Leaders on developing strategic plan.
* Works with Business Leaders on developing and meeting annual budget.
* Responsible for overall profit and loss management of operations.
* Responsible for managing local vendor relations and accounts payable management.
* Responsible for monitoring staffing levels in all operations in order to maintain operational efficiency.
* Ensures that all field staff maintain a high level of customer service when dealing with patients, patient families, co-responders, other healthcare providers and the general public.
* Ensures that all field staff in all operations maintain appropriate certification and licensure for their position.
* Ensures security and privacy of all company and patient information at all times in accordance HIPPA and all other local, state and federal regulations.
* Ensures that all operations are in full compliance with all local, state and federal regulations regarding the ordering, storage, use and record keeping of controlled substances.
* Ensures that all operations are in full compliance with all company policies regarding clinical protocols and field documentation.
* Ensures that all operations are in full compliance with all local, state and federal contracts, regulations and ordinances.
* Displays a positive mental attitude toward the position held, the company, and its employees, clients, partners or affiliates.
* Clearly, effectively, and professionally express him/herself verbally and in writing,
* Responds to all incidents involving serious personal injury, excessive damage to company equipment or excessive damage to private property involving company personnel or equipment.
* Monitor the use of services, vehicles, equipment, facilities, and staff to ensure effective use of resources and assess the need for additional staff, equipment, and services.
* Review and analyze facility activities and data to aid planning and risk management to improve service utilization and quality.
* Direct, supervise and evaluate work activities of all personnel assigned to the Operations Division.
* Facilitate communication between EMS staff, support staff, and members of management as appropriate.
* Establish and implement operations division policies, goals, objectives, and procedures.
* Review financial statements, sales and activity reports, and other performance data to measure productivity and goal achievement and to determine areas needing cost reduction and program improvement.
* Responsible for annual re-certification of all ambulances.
* Maintains and ensures compliance of Standard Operating Procedures for all company operations.
* Ensures completion of annual skills evaluation for all personnel as needed.
* Assists other division directors as needed.
* Develop and maintain computerized record management systems to store, process data, and produce reports, such as personnel activities and information.
* Coordinate activities as appropriate with other division leaders concerned with reference to pricing, sales, training, human resources or distribution of services.
* Determine staffing requirements, and assist other division directors with interviewing, hiring and training new employees as needed.
* Maintain awareness of advances in EMS diagnostic and treatment equipment, data processing technology, government regulations, health insurance changes, and financing options.
* Performs other duties as directed by management.

#IND1

**Minimum Requirements:**

* All Paramedic requirements (Current Paramedic Certification)
 + Must possess a high degree of personal integrity and responsibility.
 + Currently licensed, certified or registered by the appropriate state agencies.
 + Currently certified in CPR by the AHA or other appropriate organization.
 + Currently certified in ACLS, PALS and/or other specialty certifications as required.
 + Currently licensed with the appropriate level of state motor vehicle operator’s license.
 + Currently has a clean driving record in accordance with company standards.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to work effectively with minimal supervision, using good judgment.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to work efficiently and interact in a constructive and professional manner with other employees, public safety personnel and medical staff.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to interact effectively and professionally with patients, customers, clients, family members, bystanders, and the general public in such a manner as to reflect positively on the company.
 + Must demonstrate a level of skill and ability consistent with the provision of high-quality patient care.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to perform effectively as team leader and team member in patient care situations.
 + Must have and demonstrate the ability to perform effectively in carrying out public relations and community education functions with members of the medical community and general public in promoting the company.
* All Paramedic Field Supervisor requirements
* Must have and demonstrate the ability function as a leader evaluating, coaching, training and directing field staff.
* Must have and demonstrate solid business management and administrative skills

**Physical Requirements:**

* The ability to reach, push and pull.
* The ability to sit or stand for long periods of time.
* The ability to complete all job duties during any and all hours of the day and night.
* The ability to use mouse or keyboard to input data into computer over long periods of time.
* The ability to view graphic and text data on multiple computer screens for long periods of times.

TOGETHER, WE SAVE LIVES
 
 
Summary
 
The Operations Director is responsible for developing and executing the operations strategy for the Jacksonville body armor manufacturing facility. This role provides site leadership across manufacturing operations, manufacturing engineering, maintenance, continuous improvement, and operational excellence to ensure safe, efficient, and scalable execution aligned with company objectives.
 
The Operations Director serves as a champion of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and the Cadre Operating Model, driving a culture of continuous improvement while building organizational structures, leadership capability, and operational systems that support growth and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 

* Develop and execute the operations strategy to support facility performance, growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
* Lead manufacturing operations and manufacturing engineering functions to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and productivity objectives.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Engineering, Product Development, Customer Service, Quality, and HR to align operational capabilities with business priorities.
* Establish performance goals, KPIs, and accountability systems that drive results across the organization.
* Lead capacity planning, labor planning, capital investment, and operational readiness for growth, new products, and facility expansion.
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and structured problem solving methodologies to improve operational performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on throughput, quality, lead time reduction, waste elimination, labor efficiency, and cost optimization.
* Provide strategic oversight of automation, process improvement, manufacturing technology, and capital projects to enhance operational capability and scalability.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, regulatory, customer, and environmental requirements while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
* Build organizational capability through leadership development, succession planning, workforce planning, and organizational design.
* Manage operational budgets and business performance through data-driven decision making, operational reviews, and corrective action planning.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Education
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field required.
* Master's degree preferred.

Experience
 

* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 5+ years leading managers and multi-functional operational organizations.
* Proven experience leading manufacturing operations in a complex, high-mix manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and Operational Excellence systems.
* Strong experience leading organizational transformation, culture change, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing manufacturing engineering, automation, capital projects, and process improvement programs.
* Background in ballistic armor, protective equipment, defense, aerospace, composites, or similarly regulated manufacturing environments preferred.
* Experience working within environments requiring strict quality, traceability, regulatory, and customer compliance standards.

Preferred Certifications
 

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt.

Key Competencies
 

* Strategic thinker with a strong operational mindset.
* Proven ability to lead through influence and drive cross functional alignment.
* Skilled coach and developer of leaders and teams.
* Builds accountability while fostering a respectful and engaged culture.
* Deep understanding of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of value stream management, operational metrics, and performance systems.
* Strong financial and operational decision making skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, operational capability, and business priorities.
* Experience driving growth while maintaining operational discipline.

Physical & Work Environment
 

* Regular presence on the manufacturing floor.
* Ability to work around industrial equipment, materials, and PPE requirements.
* Occasional travel to other company locations, suppliers, and customers.
* Occasional extended hours or off-shift support based on business needs.

At Safariland our colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry and we are seeking new team members who exhibit the diverse competencies that will drive The Safariland Group to even greater success while maintaining our culture of being a great place to work. The Safariland Group believes in the benefits of a diverse workforce and is committed to equal opportunity and affirmative actions. We pride ourselves on hiring and developing the best people, without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic characteristics, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, alienage, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally recognized protected basis prohibited by applicable law.

ABOUT THE ROLE
 
Lead quality for a mission-critical manufacturing operation where product performance directly supports customer trust and mission success. As Director of Quality, you will strengthen quality systems, build high-performing teams, and ensure precision-manufactured products meet demanding customer and government requirements.
 
 
You will partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to drive reliable performance across weapons, defense contracting, aerospace, and other highly regulated programs. * Strong knowledge of inspection practices, dimensional verification, engineering drawings, GD&T, and precision measurement equipment
* Experience implementing or maintaining a QMS aligned with ISO 9001, AS9100, or equivalent standards
